banner.title: homepage
banner.tagline: Serves the internal start page: services from YAML, cluster state from the Kubernetes API, and widgets fed by 1Password.

explainer.title: Config in Git, state from the API

steps.title: Config
steps.text: ConfigMap homepage-config mounts six YAML files at /app/config: bookmarks, services, settings, widgets, docker and kubernetes.

steps.title: Secrets
steps.text: ExternalSecret homepage-secret pulls the unifi, nas and grafana items from 1Password into the pod environment.
steps.scene: a key emerging from a vault

steps.title: Discover
steps.text: ClusterRole homepage lets the pod read namespaces, pods, nodes, HTTPRoutes and metrics. Route annotations add the tiles.
steps.scene: a grid of service tiles with a radar sweep

steps.title: Render
steps.text: The app serves the dashboard on port 3000 through the envoy-internal HTTPRoute, with the ServiceAccount token mounted for the cluster widgets.
steps.scene: a browser window of dashboard tiles
